title: 12 Best Day Trips from Bangkok
description: Explore the best day trips from Bangkok in 2026! Discover historical parks, floating markets, stunning beaches, and cultural gems just a short journey from the bustling city.

places.name: Ayutthaya Historical Park
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A boat trip around the historical island to see temples from a different perspective, and try Ayutthaya's famous Roti Sai Mai (cotton candy crepe).

places.name: Damnoen Saduak Floating Market & Maeklong Railway Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Coconut ice cream and boat noodle soup at Damnoen Saduak, and a fresh fruit juice from a stall at Maeklong as you wait for the train.

places.name: Kanchanaburi (Bridge over River Kwai & Erawan Falls)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Take a refreshing dip in as many tiers of Erawan Falls as you can reach, and visit the JEATH War Museum for historical context.

places.name: Ancient City (Muang Boran)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Rent a golf cart or bicycle to navigate the expansive grounds, allowing you to stop at leisure at temples, palaces, and traditional houses.

places.name: Pattaya & Koh Larn
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Fresh seafood lunch on Koh Larn, and try a banana boat or parasailing experience at one of the island's main beaches.

places.name: Amphawa Floating Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grilled prawns or squid cooked on a boat, and definitely take the optional firefly boat tour for a magical end to the day.

places.name: Hua Hin
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A delicious seafood dinner at the Hua Hin Night Market and visit the historic Hua Hin Railway Station.

places.name: Koh Kret
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mon-style deep-fried flowers and vegetables, and pick up some handcrafted pottery as a souvenir.

places.name: Erawan Museum & Ancient Siam (Samut Prakan)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Spend ample time exploring the different levels within the elephant, each representing a distinct realm, from the underworld to the heavens.

places.name: Phra Pathom Chedi & Talad Don Wai Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Kuay Teow Moo Dang (red pork noodles) from a stall near the Chedi and some of the famous Nakhon Pathom pomelos at Talad Don Wai.

places.name: Sriracha & Koh Si Chang
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Fresh seafood at a local restaurant on Koh Si Chang and enjoy a tuk-tuk ride around the island's sights.

places.name: Khao Kheow Open Zoo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The safari bus tour, which offers convenient access and guided insights, and the opportunity to hand-feed some of the friendly animals like giraffes.
